response.text: Strewth, are ya mad as a cut snake? Beats me. Yer carrying on like a pork chop, you're a stubby short of a six-pack'n a big-noter, and I'm flat out cleaning up after ya, ya drongo. Fair dinkum, I'm starvin', with a belly growling like a mixer full of rocks, let's 'ave a feed at Macca's. Well, the tap in my bloody unit is bung. Jeez, then they lost their bloody tents and chairs, the whole kit 'n caboodle. So anyway, he's thick as two short planks and a bull artist. Now, 'ave a cup of tea, a Bex'n a bloody good lie-down'n stop whingeing, like a loose sheet of tin in the wind. Anyway, I'm going to the store. Streeeewth.
